# scqc-python: 3.12.13
# The analysis environment (`core`): every package of its closure at one exact version. setup/install_env.sh
# reads the interpreter above and refuses to install into another one, applies the pins below with
# `pip install --no-deps`, so nothing is resolved at build time, and then compares every installed version
# with this file; a difference refuses the build.
#
# These are the versions of the cluster environment the calibration runs used: its `pip freeze`, on
# python 3.12.13 - the version every analysis call record writes down (`versions.python`), so the patch is
# part of the lock. Every pin has a wheel for linux x86_64 with glibc >= 2.28 (pyarrow 25.0.0 has no older
# one) and for macOS on arm64.
#
# pyarrow is here because the suite needs it: tests/test_native_io.py sets pandas' string storage to
# "pyarrow", which pandas refuses where pyarrow is not installed. An earlier version of this file was a
# workstation's freeze - a notebook stack, a Windows-only terminal, no pyarrow, and not a closure on linux -
# while the cluster's lock beside it, which no script read, held these 55.
